snippet.title: The Playing Field 2 Flash Game (God's Playing Field Sequel)
snippet.description:
The Playing Field 2 is a flash game sequel to God's Playing Field.  There's not really much of a story at all though, and it's a much shorter game.  The graphics got a nice upgrade though, along with the weapon selection.

The most interesting part of the game is the last secret code you get.  You can unlock many hidden stages that are otherwise impossible to see, which was pretty neat.
